title: GTA 6 Gameplay Leaked: New Footage Shows Actual Build and Cops
description: Recent reports indicate new GTA 6 gameplay clips have surfaced online, showing Jason playing basketball and triggering police pursuits.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Gameplay Leak Surfaces: Reports Suggest Leaker Has Actual Build

The anticipation surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming *Grand Theft Auto VI* continues to drive massive online discussion, with a fresh wave of unverified leaks capturing the attention of the gaming community. According to recent reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, multiple clips depicting what appear to be legitimate *GTA 6* gameplay have been posted online.

Based on these reports, the circulating footage includes at least two distinct clips. The first reportedly features the male protagonist Jason at his house—reminiscent of locations seen in the official trailer—engaging in activities like playing basketball. The second clip showcases driving mechanics and criminal activities that draw the attention and response of in-game police officers. While direct links to the footage are widely omitted by major outlets, the videos remain easily discoverable through searches on various social media platforms.

## Context and Industry Perspective

Leaks and rumors have historically accompanied the development cycles of major blockbuster titles, and *GTA 6* is no exception. Following previous large-scale security breaches during early development phases, any new piece of media claiming to show the game tends to spread rapidly across online forums and social networks.

It is crucial to emphasize that **Rockstar Games has not issued any official statement or confirmation** regarding the authenticity of these recently posted videos. Because development builds frequently change and evolve long before a title's final commercial release, community members should approach all unverified footage with caution.

## Editor's Take

Navigating the hype surrounding *GTA 6* can be challenging with constant internet leaks. While curiosity is natural, relying on official channels for updates ensures the best experience. Patience remains the best approach as we wait for Rockstar Games to share authentic updates.
